herald.label: Table announcement

s_swap_one.name: Card Swap
s_swap_one.desc: Your lowest hole card is redealt, for 1 hand.

s_luck_1.name: Small Lucky Charm
s_luck_1.desc: Two sets of hole cards are dealt and you keep the better one, for 1 hand.

s_high_card.name: High Card Boost
s_high_card.desc: Your hole cards are sure to include a 10 or higher, for 1 hand.

s_suited.name: Suited
s_suited.desc: Your first two hole cards share a suit, for 1 hand.

s_redeal_weak.name: Redeal a Weak Hand
s_redeal_weak.desc: With no pair and nothing J or higher, your hole cards are redealt once, for 1 hand.

s_peek_1.name: Sneak Peek
s_peek_1.desc: See 1 community card before you play or fold, for 1 hand.

s_free_fold.name: Free Fold
s_free_fold.desc: If you fold, your opening wager is refunded, for 1 hand.

s_insure_half.name: Silver Insurance
s_insure_half.desc: If you lose, 50% of what you put in comes back, for 1 hand.

s_shield.name: Wooden Shield
s_shield.desc: Blocks the next harmful card aimed at you.

s_rescue.name: Silver Rescue
s_rescue.desc: After a lost hand that leaves you under 2 wagers, you get 5 × the wager.

s_charge.name: Charge Up
s_charge.desc: Gives you 3 chaos points at once.

s_steal_one.name: Pluck a Card
s_steal_one.desc: At the reveal, 1 random opponent loses a random hole card.

s_lower.name: Lower a Card
s_lower.desc: At the reveal, the highest hole card of 1 random opponent is redealt.

s_blindfold.name: Blindfold
s_blindfold.desc: 1 random opponent cannot look at their hole cards next hand.

s_freeze_one.name: Small Freeze
s_freeze_one.desc: 1 random opponent cannot use their cards next hand.

s_crit.name: Silver Crit
s_crit.desc: When you win, a 20% chance to double your net win, for 3 hands.

s_fortune.name: Silver Fortune
s_fortune.desc: Waits; when you win right after losing 2 or more hands in a row you get a reward, bigger the longer the streak.

s_level.name: Silver Level-Up
s_level.desc: Turns at once into 1 random Gold card.

g_swap_all.name: Full Swap
g_swap_all.desc: With no pair and nothing Q or higher, all your hole cards are redealt, for 1 hand.

g_luck_3.name: Lucky Charm
g_luck_3.desc: Two sets of hole cards are dealt and you keep the better one, for 3 hands.

g_extra_card.name: Extra Card
g_extra_card.desc: You get 1 more hole card, for 1 hand.

g_peek_3.name: Gold Sneak Peek
g_peek_3.desc: See 3 community cards before you play or fold, for 1 hand.

g_borrow.name: Borrow a Card
g_borrow.desc: At the reveal, you also use 1 hole card of a random opponent; they keep it.

g_insure_full.name: Gold Insurance
g_insure_full.desc: If you lose, everything you put in comes back, for 1 hand.

g_shield_3.name: Iron Shield
g_shield_3.desc: Blocks every harmful card aimed at you, for 3 hands.

g_rescue.name: Gold Rescue
g_rescue.desc: After a lost hand that leaves you under 2 wagers, you get 10 × the wager.

g_farm.name: Point Farm
g_farm.desc: Your chaos points are doubled, for 5 hands.

g_steal_all.name: Pluck from Everyone
g_steal_all.desc: At the reveal, every opponent loses a hole card.

g_redeal_board_1.name: Redeal a Board Card
g_redeal_board_1.desc: 1 random community card is redealt, for the whole table.

g_freeze_all.name: Table Freeze
g_freeze_all.desc: Every opponent cannot use their cards next hand.

g_crit.name: Gold Crit
g_crit.desc: When you win, a 25% chance of ×2 and a 10% chance of ×3 on your net win, for 3 hands.

g_fortune.name: Gold Fortune
g_fortune.desc: Waits; when you win right after losing 2 or more hands in a row you get a reward, bigger the longer the streak.

g_level.name: Gold Level-Up
g_level.desc: Turns at once into 1 random Diamond card.

d_pick_3.name: Pick a Hand
d_pick_3.desc: Three sets of hole cards are dealt and you keep the best one, for 1 hand.

d_luck_5.name: Grand Lucky Charm
d_luck_5.desc: Two sets of hole cards are dealt and you keep the better one, for 5 hands.

d_extra_card_3.name: Diamond Extra Card
d_extra_card_3.desc: You get 1 more hole card, for 3 hands.

d_peek_5.name: Clairvoyance
d_peek_5.desc: See all 5 community cards before you play or fold, for 1 hand.

d_insure_2.name: Diamond Insurance
d_insure_2.desc: If you lose, everything you put in comes back, for 2 hands.

d_mirror.name: Mirror
d_mirror.desc: Sends the next harmful card aimed at you back at whoever used it.

d_rescue.name: Diamond Rescue
d_rescue.desc: After a lost hand that leaves you under 2 wagers, you get 20 × the wager (within the daily cap).

d_swap_hands.name: Hand Trade
d_swap_hands.desc: At the reveal, you trade all hole cards with 1 random opponent.

d_storm.name: Board Storm
d_storm.desc: All 5 community cards are redealt, for the whole table.

d_reverse.name: Upside-Down World
d_reverse.desc: The weakest hand takes the pot this hand; the whole table is told from the deal.

d_crit.name: Diamond Crit
d_crit.desc: When you win, a 30% chance of ×2 and a 15% chance of ×3 on your net win, for 3 hands.

d_fortune.name: Diamond Fortune
d_fortune.desc: Waits; when you win right after losing 2 or more hands in a row you get a reward, bigger the longer the streak.

d_gambler.name: Gambler
d_gambler.desc: Each hand applies the random effect of one Silver or Gold card, until the next draft.

d_level.name: Diamond Level-Up
d_level.desc: Turns at once into 2 random cards, each of a random tier from Silver to Diamond.

s_tier_up.name: Power Up
s_tier_up.desc: Waits; the next card you receive (draft or bonus) comes one tier higher; a Diamond stays a Diamond.

s_no_fold.name: No Folding
s_no_fold.desc: Next hand, nobody else may fold; they can only play.

s_duel.name: Silver Duel
s_duel.desc: At the reveal, you challenge 1 random opponent still in the hand; if your hand beats theirs, a 25% chance they pay you 2 wagers.

s_hawk_eye.name: Hawk Eye
s_hawk_eye.desc: See 1 random hole card of 1 random opponent before you choose to play or fold, for 1 hand.

s_coin_flip.name: Coin Toss
s_coin_flip.desc: A coin toss: this hand you get 1 extra hole card or lose 1.

s_master.name: Master
s_master.desc: Waits; win your next hand and you get 3 chaos points.

s_loss_points.name: Every Bit Counts
s_loss_points.desc: Each hand you lose gives you 1 chaos point, for 5 hands.

s_redeal_hole.name: Reshuffle
s_redeal_hole.desc: At the reveal, 1 random hole card of 1 random opponent is redealt.

s_neighbour_swap.name: Neighbour Swap
s_neighbour_swap.desc: At the reveal, 1 random hole card of yours is swapped with one of the player on your left, if still in the hand.

s_spoiler.name: Spoiler
s_spoiler.desc: Switches off 1 random card that 1 random opponent has in play this hand.

s_kindling.name: Kindling
s_kindling.desc: Everyone at the table gets 1 chaos point each hand, for 3 hands.

s_dice.name: Silver Lucky Die
s_dice.desc: When the hand ends, roll 1 die: 3–4 gives 2 chaos points, 5 a Silver card, 6 a Gold card.

g_aces_charge.name: Gold Ace Surge
g_aces_charge.desc: Each hand adds a 5–7% chance of a pair of Aces (up to 60%); it ends when it hits, up to 20 hands.

g_flip_flop.name: Flip-Flop
g_flip_flop.desc: Alternates 1 extra hole card and 1 fewer, starting with the extra; in a short hand nobody can take your cards, for 4 hands.

g_big_table.name: High Stakes
g_big_table.desc: The whole table bets twice the base wager; you get 2 sets of hole cards and keep the better, for 3 hands.

g_duel.name: Gold Duel
g_duel.desc: At the reveal, you challenge 1 random opponent still in the hand; if your hand beats theirs, a 30% chance they pay you 2 wagers, 10% that they pay 3.

g_steal_points.name: Point Thief
g_steal_points.desc: Takes 5 chaos points at once from whoever has the most.

g_scapegoat.name: Scapegoat
g_scapegoat.desc: Waits; the next harmful card aimed at you goes to another random player instead.

g_hawk_eye.name: Gold Hawk Eye
g_hawk_eye.desc: See all the hole cards of 1 random opponent before you choose to play or fold, for 1 hand.

g_swap_hands.name: Reckless Trade
g_swap_hands.desc: At the reveal, you trade all hole cards with 1 random opponent still in the hand.

g_sixth_board.name: Sixth Card
g_sixth_board.desc: This hand has 6 community cards for the whole table; everyone makes their best 5.

g_win_tax.name: Winner's Tax
g_win_tax.desc: Whoever wins a hand (other than you) pays you 10% of their profit, for 3 hands.

g_curse.name: Curse
g_curse.desc: Each hand, the highest hole card of 1 random opponent turns into a 2, for 3 hands.

g_fate_die.name: Die of Fate
g_fate_die.desc: At the reveal, roll 1 die: 1–2 you lose 1 hole card, 3–4 nothing, 5–6 one extra card and a ×2 crit if you win.

g_dice.name: Gold Lucky Dice
g_dice.desc: When the hand ends, roll 2 dice: 2 loses 1 wager, 3–6 gives 3 chaos points, 7–9 a Gold card, 10–11 a Diamond card, 12 a 10 × wager jackpot.

d_carp.name: Carp to Dragon
d_carp.desc: Waits; each lost hand adds 5–7% energy, and a hit makes you the Card God for 5 hands; win before that and you become a Demigod.

d_aces_charge.name: Ace Surge
d_aces_charge.desc: Each hand adds a 5–7% chance of all Aces, certain at 100%; it ends when it hits, up to 20 hands.

d_risky_hand.name: All or Nothing
d_risky_hand.desc: One hole card fewer, but 3 sets dealt and the best kept, and nobody can take your cards; a win crits ×3, ×4 or ×5 and ends the card, up to 10 hands.

d_adventurer.name: Adventurer
d_adventurer.desc: Your own wager goes ×2, ×4, ×8, ×16, ×32 hand by hand until you win; a win pays a 5 × wager jackpot and 5 chaos points, up to 5 hands.

d_share_winnings.name: Fair Share
d_share_winnings.desc: If you are still in the hand and lose, the winner pays you half their profit, for 2 hands.

d_plunder.name: Plunder
d_plunder.desc: You drop your hole cards and take from your opponents' the cards that make the strongest hand; they get replacements, for 2 hands.

d_shuffle_holes.name: Fate's Shuffle
d_shuffle_holes.desc: At the reveal, the hole cards of everyone still in the hand (you too) are shuffled among them.

d_swap_leader.name: Against the Tide
d_swap_leader.desc: At the reveal, if you are not in the lead, you trade hole cards with whoever is.

d_backfire.name: Backfire
d_backfire.desc: This hand, every harmful card of the others bounces back at whoever used it.

d_deluge.name: The Flood
d_deluge.desc: At the reveal, the hole cards of everyone still in the hand and all 5 community cards are redealt.

d_eclipse.name: Eclipse
d_eclipse.desc: This hand every card of the others is switched off (not lost); only yours run.

d_wild_card.name: Ghost Card
d_wild_card.desc: 1 random hole card of yours becomes wild, counting as any card that makes your best hand, for 1 hand.

d_time_bomb.name: Time Bomb
d_time_bomb.desc: Plants a bomb on 1 random opponent; it passes to someone else each hand, and after 3 hands whoever holds it pays you 1 wager.

d_dice.name: Diamond Lucky Dice
d_dice.desc: When the hand ends, roll 3 dice and add them up: from losing 2 wagers to a 30 × wager jackpot; three of a kind doubles the prize.

avatar.greet: Your figure, tap to say hi
